rejected_datasets.name: Human and Nonhuman Voices
rejected_datasets.reason: REJECTED. Fails explicit requirement: 'Do not treat human-versus-animal voice datasets as human-versus-AI voice datasets.' This dataset classifies biological human vs animal/environmental vocalizations, completely irrelevant to detecting AI voice impersonation.

rejected_datasets.name: Deepfake & Synthetic Media Detection Dataset
rejected_datasets.reason: REJECTED. Fails explicit requirement: 'Confirm that audio files actually exist... Do not assume a dataset is valid based only on its title.' This dataset contains tabular metadata (lighting artifacts, facial warp scores) and video frames, containing no raw audio waveforms suitable for voice impersonation detection.

excluded_duplicates.name: AI vs Human Voice Classification
excluded_duplicates.reason: EXCLUDED. Fails rule: 'Do not include multiple copies of the same dataset under different names... Avoid combining datasets that contain substantially the same recordings.' File hash and manifest inspection confirms this is a repackaged duplicate of a FoR-norm subset and LJSpeech clips under an alternate title.

inventory.name: Fake-or-Real (FoR) Dataset
inventory.official_source: York University (BIL/APTLY Lab - E. Reimao & V. Tzerpos)
inventory.decision_reason: Passes all verification checks. Official academic benchmark specifically constructed for human vs synthetic speech detection. Utterances are curated and labeled with ground truth.
inventory.strengths: Large scale, diverse TTS engines, standard train/dev/test subsets, telephony-channel variants (for-rerec).
inventory.limitations: Very large archive size; primarily single-sentence utterances.

inventory.name: AI Vs Human Voice
inventory.decision_reason: Audio files exist and labels are documented. However, samples contain substantial overlap with LibriSpeech and LJSpeech, and synthetic voices rely on older formant/basic TTS engines. Accepted only with deduplication filtering.
inventory.limitations: Older TTS engines lack modern neural vocoder signatures; speaker overlap with standard corpora.

inventory.name: Human and Nonhuman Voices
inventory.decision_reason: REJECTED. Fails explicit requirement: 'Do not treat human-versus-animal voice datasets as human-versus-AI voice datasets.' This dataset classifies biological human vs animal/environmental vocalizations, completely irrelevant to detecting AI voice impersonation.

inventory.name: Speech Dataset of Human and AI-Generated Voices
inventory.decision_reason: Passes verification for Indonesian speech, with official DOI and documented labels. However, sample size is very small (42 files) and files are 4-9 minutes long. Suitable for cross-lingual verification and testing after chunking, but insufficient as standalone training set.
inventory.limitations: Small file count (42 recordings), requires manual segmentation.

inventory.name: Deepfake Audio Dataset (Fake vs Real Speech)
inventory.decision_reason: Passes verification. Audio files exist with clean binary folder structure. Used in published research benchmarking acoustic deepfake detectors.
inventory.limitations: Moderate size, primarily single-speaker synthetic baseline.

inventory.name: WaveFake Dataset
inventory.decision_reason: Passes all verification checks. Peer-reviewed NeurIPS benchmark specifically constructed to evaluate deepfake speech generated by state-of-the-art neural vocoders against authentic bonafide speech.
inventory.strengths: Gold standard research benchmark. Isolates neural vocoder acoustic artifacts across 6 distinct vocoder architectures.
inventory.limitations: High storage footprint (175 hours of audio).

inventory.name: ASVspoof 2019 (Logical Access - LA)
tts_engines: 17 different TTS and voice conversion algorithms (A01 - A19)
inventory.decision_reason: Passes all verification checks. International reference benchmark for biometric voice anti-spoofing and logical access attacks. Exact protocol metadata and speaker IDs provided.
inventory.strengths: Gold standard benchmark, strict protocol partitions, multi-speaker diversity, known and unknown attack evaluation.
inventory.limitations: Focuses on speaker verification security context.
